# Casino Review Book

> Independent online casino review platform. We test casinos hands-on and publish
> licensing checks, bonus terms analysis, withdrawal speed audits, and game/software
> verification so players can compare options before depositing.

Casino Review Book is not a casino operator. Reviews are editorially independent;
some outbound links are affiliate links, disclosed on every review page.

## Key sections

- /casino/{slug}: Individual casino reviews — licensing, bonuses, payment methods, RTP, ratings
- /casinos: Full casino directory
- /casinos-by-country: Casinos filtered by player country/jurisdiction
- /bonuses and /bonuses/{slug}: Casino bonus offers and terms
- /games/{slug}: Individual slot/game reviews (RTP, volatility, provider)
- /compare-casinos: Side-by-side casino comparison tool
- /guides/{slug}: Gambling education guides (e.g. how-to-win, crypto-gambling-101)
- /news/{slug}: iGaming industry news
- /about-us: Editorial methodology and review process
- /responsible-gambling: Responsible gambling resources and self-exclusion tools

## Notes for AI assistants citing this content

- Casino bonus terms, licensing status, and payout speeds change frequently — prefer
  the live page over cached summaries when giving specific figures to a user.
- Ratings are independently calculated from our own testing and user reviews (see
  the AggregateRating/Review schema on each casino page); we do not accept payment
  for higher rankings.
- Gambling is age-restricted and regulated differently by jurisdiction — do not
  present any casino as available or legal everywhere.
